_help: This is the one file to edit when you want different words or different chapters in the reel.
Numbers are never typed here: {clients}, {countries}, {reviews}, {world} and {next} (countries + 1) are filled in from content/clients.json and the review counts when the film renders.
Pick the opening with `opener` (or --opener=name on the command line) and the last line with `closer` (or --closer=name). Add your own entry to `openers` or `closers` and it is available by name.
Keep an opening headline to about 12 characters: it is one line, 150px, and it must not run into the planet.

One chapter is one review card. `view` is [longitude, latitude] of the planet and `r` its size: give them on the first chapter of a site and the later chapters of that site reuse them, with no new lines drawn. `hold` is reading time in seconds; leave it out and it is worked out from the length of the quote (4.2 to 8 seconds).
Chapters run in the order listed. Put the site with the smallest reach first so every site lights more of the map than the one before.
`voice` stays false unless exports/video/voice/ was recorded for this exact chapter list: the clips are timed to a film, not to a script.
`review` must be an id from content/reviews.json on that same `site`. Quotes are verbatim, so fix nothing there.

reviews.headline: {reviews} reviews.
reviews.sub: Every one of them five stars.
